title: Prophets Who Called Out and Allah Answered

paragraphs.text: Allah made the strong wind serve Solomon. It blew at his command toward the blessed land. Some devils dived for him and did other work, and Allah guarded them.

Job called to his Lord, saying that hardship had touched him. Allah answered him and removed his pain. He gave him back his family, and as many again, as a mercy. Ishmael, Idrees and Dhul-Kifl were all patient, and Allah let them into His mercy. The man of the fish left in anger. Then he called out from the darkness, "There is no deity except You. I have been one of the wrongdoers." Allah saved him from his distress, and He saves the believers in the same way. Zechariah asked not to be left without an heir. Allah gave him John and made his wife able to have a child. These people hurried to do good. They prayed in hope and fear and were humble before Allah. Allah also made Mary, who guarded her chastity, and her son a sign for the worlds.

Your religion is one religion, and Allah is your Lord, so worship Him. Yet people divided into groups, but all will return to Him. A believer's good effort will never be ignored, because Allah records it. Then Gog and Magog will be let loose and rush down from every high place. When the true promise comes near, the disbelievers will stare in horror. They will cry, "Woe to us! We were careless and wrong."

hardWords.m: a child who receives what a parent leaves
